lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct vertical line paths; 6 are continuous traversing the majority of the torso height, and 3 are highly fragmented on the posterior section; spacing is regular, approximately three times the width of a single line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates in the upper torso region; lines 7, 8, and 9 are discontinuous, appearing as a series of vertically aligned dashes and spots rather than solid lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch/upper hind limb region.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the cheek; white V-shaped chevron between the eyes; prominent white patch on the lower neck/throat; dark dorsal mane running along the spine.
